observations: body L1, L8: the heads of the notes on chapters 17 and 18, «Ad» and «caput» in small capitals, in the larger type of the heads.

body L2, L9, L17: in the heads, the dashes after «a)» and «b)» measure 10.3, 9.8 and 10.2 pt and the dash of «30–32» 5.5 pt; the dash of «31-32» measures 4.1 pt and is transcribed as a hyphen, as on p. 179.
body L4, L20: the dashes of the letter-spaced «al–Battānī» measure 5.4 pt, long dashes.
body L6: the minus sign is printed as a long dash (9.8 pt); it is set as a minus sign. The rule is rule (α) of chapter 16 solved for sin h.
body L10-L16: Schiaparelli's addition stands in heavy brackets, as on pp. 185-186; the dashes before «Tota» and before his name measure 9.5 and 10.2 pt. In «autem» the t is printed broken, like an l.

body L18-L21: rule (α) is checked: with the second declination β′, tg β′ = tg ε sin L, sin (β + β′) cos ε / cos β′ = sin β cos ε + cos β sin ε sin L, the sine of the declination of a star of longitude L and latitude β (radius 1); the lower sign when the latitude lies on the other side.

body L25-L31: the figure stands at the left of lines 25 to 31, which are set beside it in a narrow measure. It is redrawn from measurements of the print: the spherical triangle ABC with its sides produced, BC to α, AC to β and AB to γ, as arcs of circles; the transversal αβγ in dashes, each dash where it printed; the bold italic letters. The arc CB, printed with a small break with a dot in it, is drawn whole.
body L25: the heavy bracket opens Schiaparelli's addition on Menelaus' theorem, which continues on p. 193.
notes_left L1: the dash of «al-Battānī» measures 3.7 pt, a hyphen.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
